hpke_entropy_source.behavior: Go 1.26.5 crypto/hpke uses the standard library internal secure random reader for ephemeral encapsulation keys and exposes no supported entropy-injection parameter.
hpke_entropy_source.failure_semantics: NewSender returns an error if ephemeral key generation returns an error; the default platform random source is documented to fail irrecoverably if the operating-system source fails.
hpke_entropy_source.test_limit: WO-802 does not use unsupported go:linkname hooks to inject an HPKE internal-reader failure. It instead tests actual repeated encapsulation uniqueness, deterministic-test isolation, one-use context exhaustion, and the supported ECDSA entropy-error path.
hpke_entropy_source.claim: HPKE operating-system entropy failure was not induced in this test run.

rollback_ci_contributor_impact.rollback: Do not roll back below Go 1.26.5 after suite activation. Any toolchain change reruns independent fixtures, randomness cases, parser negatives, full uncached gate, and exact implementation review.
rollback_ci_contributor_impact.ci: Pin Go 1.26.5 for Phase 8 candidate CI; use -count=1 for security evidence and retain a clean-cache run in the final work order.
rollback_ci_contributor_impact.contributors: Use Go 1.26.5, do not import testing/cryptotest outside _test.go, do not reuse HPKE contexts, and do not add suite negotiation or custom entropy sources.
rollback_ci_contributor_impact.compatibility: The new direct CBOR dependency requires module download but no C toolchain or platform-specific library.
